supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Visible extension beyond the outer corners of the eyes as a 2D bounding width

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Muzzle area displays high pixel intensity (lightness) contrasted against the low intensity (darkness) of the cheek and periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Visible 2D vertical thickness with a structural droop of the lower lip

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct reddish-brown patch or lesion on the right cheek (viewer's left)
